# Dupaco knowledge system

My solution to interface.ai's knowledge assignment. It reads five snapshots of a credit union's website and answers members' questions with the current value, the right tier and a source, and it says "I don't know" when the site doesn't say. It also lists where the site contradicts itself.

The write-up is in [NOTES.md](/NOTES.md): how it works, how it decides what's current, which API keys it needs and how to run it. The code is in [submission/](/submission). The website snapshots, harness and questions come with the participant kit, so they aren't in this repository.
